mn146:23.5: sammā nu kho so bhaginiyo vadamāno vadeyyāti.
mn146:23.8: amussa hi bhante mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato mūlampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ khandhopi anicco vipariṇāmadhammo sākhāpalāsampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ
mn146:23.10: evameva kho bhaginiyo yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya
mn146:23.11: cha kho me bāhirā āyatanā aniccā
mn146:23.12: yañca kho bāhire āyatane paṭicca paṭisaṃvedemi sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā taṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammanti
mn146:23.13: sammā nu kho so bhaginiyo vadamāno vadeyyāti.
mn146:23.16: tajjaṃ tajjaṃ bhante paccayaṃ paṭicca tajjā tajjā vedanā uppajjati
mn146:23.17: tajjassa tajjassa paccayassa nirodhā tajjā tajjā vedanā nirujjhatīti.
mn146:23.19: evaṃ hetaṃ bhaginiyo hoti ariyasāvakassa yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato.
mn146:24.1: seyyathāpi bhaginiyo dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā tiṇhena govikantanena gāviṃ vikanteyya anūpahacca antaraṃ maṃsakāyaṃ anūpahacca bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ
mn146:24.2: yaṃ yadeva tattha antarā vilimaṃsaṃ antarā nahārū antarā bandhanaṃ taṃ tadeva tiṇhena govikantanena sañchindeyya saṅkanteyya samparikanteyya
mn146:24.3: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ teneva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā evaṃ vadeyya
mn146:24.5: sammā nu kho so bhaginiyo vadamāno vadeyyāti.
mn146:24.8: amu hi bhante dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā tiṇhena govikantanena gāviṃ vikanteyya anupahacca antaraṃ maṃsakāyaṃ anupahacca bāhiraṃ maṃsakāyaṃ
mn146:24.9: yaṃ yadeva tattha antarā vilimaṃsaṃ antarā nahārū antarā bandhanaṃ taṃ tadeva tiṇhena govikantanena gāviṃ sañchindeyya saṅkanteyya samparikanteyya
mn146:24.10: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ teneva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā kiñcāpi so evaṃ vadeyya
mn146:24.12: atha kho sā gāvī visaṃyuttā teneva cammena.
mn146:25.1: upamā kho me ayaṃ bhaginiyo katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayamevettha attho.
mn146:25.2: antaro maṃsakāyoti kho bhaginiyo channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn146:25.3: bāhiro cammakāyoti kho bhaginiyo channetaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn146:25.4: antarā vilimaṃsaṃ antarā nahārū antarā bandhananti kho bhaginiyo nandirāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn146:25.5: tiṇhaṃ govikantananti kho bhaginiyo ariyāyetaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ
mn146:25.6: yāyaṃ ariyā paññā antarā kilesaṃ antarā saññojanaṃ antarā bandhanaṃ sañchindati saṅkantati samparikantati.
mn146:26.1: satta kho ime bhaginiyo bojjhaṅgā yesaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn146:26.3: idha bhaginiyo bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmaṃ
mn146:26.9: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmaṃ.
mn146:26.10: ime kho bhaginiyo satta bojjhaṅgā yesaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
mn146:26.11: atha kho āyasmā nandako tā bhikkhuniyo iminā ovādena ovaditvā uyyojesi
mn146:26.13: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmato nandakassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavā etadavoca
mn146:26.15: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
mn146:27.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantāsu tāsu bhikkhunīsu bhikkhū āmantesi
mn146:27.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave tadahuposathe paṇṇarase na hoti bahuno janassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā
mn146:27.3: ūno nu kho cando puṇṇo nu kho candoti atha kho puṇṇo cando tveva hoti
mn146:27.4: evameva kho bhikkhave tā bhikkhuniyo nandakassa dhammadesanāya attamanā ceva paripuṇṇasaṅkappā ca.
mn146:27.5: tāsaṃ bhikkhave pañcannaṃ bhikkhunīsatānaṃ yā pacchimikā bhikkhunī sā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanāti.
mn146:27.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
